title: 森林小镇场景原画

reference_images.role: User supplied environment style and lighting reference
Current protagonist identity, pixel treatment and three-quarter orientation

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one finished wide 16:9 environment concept painting for the existing yu HD-2D game.
Primary request: 森林中的小镇场景原画。根据现有狐耳剑士的色块像素画风与当前游戏镜头，参考所附场景图片的像素语言和光影设计，设计一张完整的新场景。
Input images: Image 1 is the user's environment STYLE reference only: transfer the clean stepped pixel shapes, large cool teal shadow masses, muted cream and dusty warm timber highlights, sparse carefully placed dithering, decisive angular cast shadows and peaceful storybook atmosphere. Do not copy its windmill composition or its high-angle camera. Image 2 is the CURRENT protagonist reference: preserve the golden fox ears, golden side ponytail, single large cream-tipped tail, golden capelet, cream blouse, caramel brown vest and opaque tights, natural slender proportions and broad steel greatsword. Use the second image to match character rendering, proportions, scale and three-quarter side-facing orientation, never as a giant portrait.
Camera/composition: wide landscape 16:9 single full-bleed scene, current game's near-eye-level camera, roughly 4 degrees downward pitch, moderate 30 degree vertical field of view. Horizontally framed HD-2D side/three-quarter game view. Building front facades and upright tree trunks dominate; roof tops and ground have only shallow visible depth. No isometric, bird's-eye, tactical overhead map or miniature cutaway. A readable foreground village street spans the frame; paths and overlapping buildings recede naturally into the woods. Place the small protagonist on the lower-middle street at about 13 percent of the picture height, standing three-quarter toward the right, holding her greatsword at rest, fully integrated into the same scale and lighting.
Scene: an intimate inhabited woodland town nestled between enormous old trees. Six to eight modest cottages in a coherent vernacular: cream lime plaster, chunky warm dark timber frames, steep weathered ochre and dusty muted terracotta roofs, a few broad moss patches, simple wooden doors and shutters. A taller inn anchors the middle distance, several smaller homes overlap behind it, and one partially cropped nearer cottage helps frame the view. The town belongs within the forest rather than clearing all trees: immense trunks between houses, layered broad leaf canopies arching overhead, deep forest visible through street gaps. A pale earthen and irregular flat-stone main street stays clearly walkable; a few simple steps, low stone edges and small ferns connect house entrances to the street. Keep object count restrained and architecture readable. Small canopy openings reveal bits of pale sky.
Lighting/mood: tranquil sunlit forest afternoon. Warm cream-gold sunlight from upper left strikes roofs, plaster walls and selective broad patches of the road; large connected cool turquoise and deep blue-green canopy shadows unify the scene. Strong designed long shadows consistent across architecture, trees and the small character. The far woods simplify into quieter cooler silhouettes. Friendly, lived-in, slightly mysterious, no threatening horror mood.
Style/medium: authored pixel-art concept painting built from large connected flat color clusters, natural material colors at silhouettes, clean pixel stair-step edges, each material primarily two or three value planes, restrained palette around 32 to 40 principal scene colors. Simplify foliage into sculpted broad canopy masses, simplify roof shingles and wood into selective structural marks. Protagonist keeps her golden, cream and brown local colors. Convey distance by shape overlap and color grouping. Sparse dithering only at a few transition edges, much less texture than the environment reference. Consistent visible logical pixel scale throughout, readable at game size.
Constraints: the scene and town are the main subject, protagonist is a scale reference. One polished coherent image, no split panels, no layout sheet, no interface, no title, no labels, no readable signs, no watermark. No photographic textures, painterly brush grain, gradients, bloom, blur, depth of field, dense stippling, repeated tiny leaf or grass noise, continuous black outlines, toy diorama, chibi proportions, enormous foreground character, top-down or isometric camera.
